title: Restore the viseme-aa mouth aperture on the current inspection GLB and bind its byte provenance
objective: Read the reviewed handoff at tools/openclinxr/evidence/delegation/viseme-aa-restoration-2026-09-15/handoff.json before editing. At baseline d806cab5, the tracked mpfb-viseme-inspect.glb has a real geometry regression: viseme_aa opens 0.0010300874710083008 m against the unchanged teeth-derived 0.020725011825561523 m threshold, while open-mouth-interior.json still claims the former 0.023833762854337692 m aperture. Restore the existing jaw-open augmentation on the current face-preserving, tight-jeans inspection asset by updating only the bake station's stale topology guards, running that station on the tracked GLB, regenerating the measured JSON with the unchanged instrument, updating the two tests' stale topology/post-bake pins, and recording the new output SHA-256 and byte count in the declaration-only sidecar. Add assetPath to that sidecar and add a named non-vacuity clause to the existing shipped-humanoid provenance suite proving mpfb-viseme-inspect.provenance.json enters provenanceRows() and matches its GLB. Preserve an honest RED from the unchanged live-aa suite before product edits; do not convert it to it.fails. The disposable prototype at cdb4032d augmented 114 existing lower-lip sparse entries, solved 0.23164898561492572 rad, produced a 0.02383376359939593 m gap, SHA-256 053e161d441a2b140ef02e926297aeabb5ecebc3dfb5a4c10edda036930c2691, and 13,933,000 bytes. Derive those results by running the station and probe; do not type binary output or copy the prototype if rebase measurements differ. This card restores a Q5 inspection fixture only. It makes no learner-facing cast or reusable-factory claim.
